contract.status: PB1 neutral contract; planned experimental work; not ratified; not part of Brontide Base

purpose: The unified observation set every completed or rejected interaction can report. PB0 classified C9 as fixture-specific because the experiments expose only 'providerEffectCount', 'crossedBoundaries', and correlation identities, and the universal form was explicitly not ratified.

governingRule.rule: Diagnostics do not drive portable semantics. An observation records what happened; it never decides what happens.
governingRule.consequence: A parity check compares the normative fields below. Non-normative fields may differ between realizations without failing parity.

normativeFields.detail: The provider that answered, carried from the Binding Plan.
Payload and resource copies across the seam. A forbidden implicit copy is visible here rather than inferred.
Projections and adapter obligations discharged, such as an additive projection from Shape version 2 to version 1.
Version 0.1 makes no retry promise, so the value is always 0; the field exists so a future retry is not silently invisible.

Known non-negative count where the observer can attribute provider effects. The value is 'unknown' when timeout, interruption, peer loss, malformed correlation, or another declared boundary prevents attribution; absence must never be rewritten as zero.

nonNormativeFields.detail: The endpoint's own diagnostic code. Never drives semantics; see CH-14-PROTOCOL-CODE-MAPPING.
Human-readable diagnostic text. Must contain no exception, stack trace, or runtime type name.

fields.name: hostNativeExecution
fields.rule: Distinct from every Channel correlation identity, per the Channel identity rule.

timingObservation.determinismRule: Timing values are observations, never inputs to a semantic decision. Parity checks exclude them because they are not category-level facts.

excludedFields.reason: A direct-call realization has no wire representation to compare.
The realization is exactly what differs.
Copy accounting differs by realization by design: the copied-immutable-blob flavor is 1 across a process seam and 0 in a direct call.

parityProfile.rule: Two realizations of the same vector have parity when every compared field is equal. An excluded field may differ only in the way its stated reason permits.
parityProfile.resourceParityRule: referencedResources compares 'flavor', 'ownership', 'integrityVerified', and 'accepted'; it excludes 'copies' for the reason given above.

completenessRule.rule: Every normative field is present on every terminal observation, including rejections and denials. An unobservable provider effect count uses the declared 'unknown' form rather than omission or a fabricated zero. A succeeded observation always carries a known count.

denialProfile.detail: A local denial produces a complete observation even though no frame was emitted.
